builds.name: Arena Galateaforce
builds.desc: If you have a +10 Ingrid, this is the best build for arena. +Spd is her best IV, this helps with her weapon's true damage and firesweep condition. If you want to give her an Ascendant Floret, +Atk is the best IV since it helps with Heavy Blade checks. An rally skill is flexible for arena. B Duel Cavalry is optimal for her to hit the score from 750 to 754. Since the foe cannot counterattack when she initiates combat, S D Near Trace helps Ingrid's retreat after attacking. Since Ingrid has an exclusive weapon, she does not need a C skill to boost the scoring. Although, Atk Spd Menace helps Ingrid to effectively outspeed the opponent preventing them from attacking her. Joint Drive Spd is another option, which synergises with her weapon.
builds.b: S/D Near Trace 3 / Flow N Trace 3

builds.name: Ingrid Brandl Galatrace
builds.desc: A build that can be used for hit and run. Ingrid must have a +Spd asset to help her double or sweep foes. C passive is flexible for a out of combat damage skill.

builds.name: Deadly Daphnel Defender
builds.desc:
Specials: No Quarter is a fun skill for Ingrid to have to pierce foe's damage reduction. This may require her to use Heavy Blade to trigger the special. On the other hand, Ingrid can trigger Ruptured Sky easily in two hits.
Passives: Death Blow Echo is optional. Flared Sparrow synergizes with Assassin's Strike which deals 14 damage to foe before Ingrid attacks. Flow Force 3 is her best flow skill if you want her to cancel effects that prevent her follow-up attacks.

builds.name: Pawn of Faerghus
builds.desc:
Best used at +10 and Dragonflowers granted at maximum. HP +5 is optimal to increase scoring in Pawns of Loki. If you have B Duel Cavalry 4 on Ingrid, use it for scoring. Arcane Lúin is optional but it helps increase HP of Ingrid. Despite Arcane Lúin with Null-Follow Up speed check built in, you can choose to run Flow Refresh 4 to reduce damage from foe's attacks and heal her HP. You can choose to run Assassin's Strike if you want to start with chip damage against your foe. Fatal Smoke 4 is useful to prevent your foes from healing. Savage Blow 3 helps with the chip damage.
You can choose to keep Lúin for her firesweep effect if it is in your favour, which may mean you have to run Flow Refresh so she heals after combat and can always make follow-up attacks.
